description: Existing NCR creation endpoint (specs/001-ncr-workflow) — this feature adds one new field to its success response only. Request shape, validation, status codes, and all other response fields are unchanged.

wbs_notification_matched.description: true if the NCR's wbs_number resolved to an exact or nearest-ancestor entry in the WBS Notification Registry (specs/005-wbs-notification-registry) and that contact was included as a recipient of the initial notification email; false if no match was found at any level of the WBS hierarchy.

side_effects: When wbs_notification_matched is true, the resolved registry entry's notification_email is included as an additional recipient of the notification.initial event (alongside existing QA Staff recipients) and is recorded in that event's per-recipient delivery log the same way every other recipient already is
When wbs_notification_matched is false, no additional recipient is added — existing recipients (QA Staff, CE/CS disposition request) are unaffected either way
client_behavior: views/ncr-create.jade: when wbs_notification_matched === false, show a non-blocking warning banner (in addition to, not instead of, the existing success banner) suggesting an Admin add this WBS number to the registry — per spec.md FR-006/FR-007, this never prevents or reverses the NCR creation that already succeeded
notes: This is the only endpoint whose response shape changes. POST /api/ncrs/:id/close also gains the same resolved-contact recipient behavior on notification.final_distribution (data-model.md), but its own response shape is unchanged — the closure-time warning is out of scope per spec.md (the warning is defined only for NCR creation).
